Create a 30-second cinematic AI video with Seedance 2.5, telling a complete, emotionally grounded story in a single generation. An old neighborhood barbershop is about to close for the night. Outside, the quiet street is tinted in cool blue evening light, while the interior glows with warm yellow lighting. Old photographs, barber certificates, worn tools, and faded customer portraits cover the walls, giving the space a strong sense of history.
Create a cinematic 16:9 Peking opera performance video with Seedance 2.5 in one continuous shot. Use ultra-realistic stage lighting, low-key illumination, a large-aperture shallow depth of field, and smooth, precisely controlled camera movement. Keep both performers' faces, costumes, makeup, and character identities clear and visually consistent throughout the entire sequence. Begin with the camera slowly circling Xiang Yu as he performs powerful martial-role movements, including beard swinging, armor shaking, cloud hands, firm stepping poses, and controlled spinning flips. Capture the weight of his costume, the movement of the armor, and the rhythm of each gesture with realistic motion and stable body proportions.
Create a 30-second cinematic historical short film with Seedance 2.5, inspired by the atmosphere of Qing Yu An · Yuan Xi. Use a horizontal 16:9 composition and tell a complete, visually coherent story set during the Lantern Festival in Lin'an, present-day Hangzhou, during the Southern Song dynasty. Strictly follow Southern Song architecture, clothing, hairstyles, accessories, and social customs. Under the night sky, the capital city is illuminated by thousands of silk lanterns. Wide streets are lined with layered wooden pavilions, gently curved eaves, elegant teahouses, restaurants, market stalls, and slightly wet bluestone pavement reflecting the warm lantern light.
Use Seedance 2.5 to create a 30-second cinematic 3D animated short using the white-model reference video as the sole guide for camera movement, pacing, framing, subject motion, and performance blocking. Combine it with stage keyframes to produce a dreamy, warm, fairy-tale world with childlike fantasy. Keep character designs fully consistent with the keyframes and do not alter appearances. Allow expressions to change naturally with the scene while maintaining stable identity, coherent staging, and professional cinematic control throughout.
Use Seedance 2.5 to perform a green-screen edit: keep the girl and the moss-covered stairs from the original video, and replace the green screen with a cinematic fairy-tale fantasy world. Surround the stairs with tall ancient trees, hanging vines, soft moss, ferns, wildflowers, ancient stone pillars, broken arches, glowing mushrooms, and flickering magical light particles. Maintain seamless compositing, realistic depth, and consistent lighting throughout.
Use Seedance 2.5 to turn Video 1 into a 15-second highly realistic action film short with a strong commercial blockbuster feel. Use the white-model previz as the control input for camera movement, pacing, framing, vehicle motion, and blocking. Use Image 1 to control the motorcycle's model, color, proportions, and materials, and Image 2 to control the SUV's model, color scheme, silhouette, and details. Maintain stable subject appearance, realistic vehicle physics, and professional cinematic continuity throughout.
Use Seedance 2.5 for reference-to-video generation, accurately interpreting the reference video's intention, framing, pacing, and cinematic language rather than simply transferring motion. Create a fun, cute, and heartwarming interaction between 2D characters and a realistic 3D world, with cinematic quality, consistent scale, natural lighting, reliable motion, and coherent visual storytelling. Character setting: the paper puppy @Image 1 is the size of a fist and exists as a two-dimensional 2D being. The side of the paper puppy @Image 1 is as thin as a sheet of paper. The limbs and ears of the paper puppy @Image 1 are detachable paper pieces that can separate from the torso when expressing character actions and emotions.
[Sound Edit] Use Seedance 2.5 to remove the background music and generate natural narration that matches the visuals, pacing, and overall mood of the video.
Create a Seedance 2.5 reference-based music video with beat-synced editing, VHS film grain, and precise lip sync to Audio 1. Start with an extreme close-up of the short-haired woman in Image 1 opening her eyes, then cut to a rooftop performance where Image 1, Image 2, Image 3, and Image 4 sing and dance while changing formations. Four helicopters enter, spotlights sweep the rooftop, and the falling rain stops instantly. Use an FPV camera move to circle the building and push in toward the four performers, then fade to black. Maintain strong multi-character consistency, smooth camera control, and reliable audio-driven editing throughout.

A fisheye ultra-wide macro shot gliding lightly into the interior of a giant surreal flower. Translucent petals and soft filaments curl inward from all sides, forming a dreamlike tunnel made of feathers, misty gauze, and floral tissue, creating a space that feels both softly curved and clearly defined through fisheye distortion. The inside of the flower is gently illuminated by icy blue, milky white, and green light, while the petal edges shimmer with a pearl-like glow. Pollen, mist particles, and tiny dewdrops float through the air. In the distance, faint pale-blue fuzzy plants and small highly saturated warm orange floral highlights can be seen. The overall atmosphere is ethereal, weightless, pure, and quiet, as if entering the glowing heart of a magical flower. A fusion of ultra-real materiality and dreamlike aesthetics, with heavy diffusion, low contrast, and a delicate futuristic sensibility.
Style: Surreal dreamlike realism, blending the fantastical textures of water and light. Shot type: extreme close-up, with the camera positioned only 2 cm from the eye. Lens: strong fisheye effect, macro lens, photographed straight on at eye level from a third-person frontal perspective. Focus: eye details, water ripples, and fine golden strands of hair. Focal length: 24mm prime lens. Depth of field: extremely shallow.The subject is the woman's eye and the surrounding details only. Her eye is intensely striking, with an iris that shifts between green and blue like a clear gemstone, reflecting a dreamlike scene. Her eyelashes are long, curled, and individually defined, while delicate golden strands of hair frame the area with a light, graceful movement. Because the framing is tightly focused on the eye, no body or pose is shown—only the expression within the eye region. Her gaze feels ethereal and dreamlike, as if holding countless stars within it.The background is a fantastical interplay of water ripples and shimmering light, with blue-green gradients and sparkling highlights like starlight. Effects include refracted light and flowing water-ripple distortions to heighten the surreal atmosphere. The image should be ultra-high-definition, with professional lighting and extremely rich tonal layering around the eye. Refraction creates vivid color variations, emphasizing the gemstone-like quality of the iris. Use a centered composition, with the eye placed at the visual core.The mood is dreamy and mysterious, with warm and cool light interwoven to trace the contours of the water, hair, and iris. The final image should feel exquisitely detailed, realistic yet surreal, combining the beauty of an extreme eye close-up with luminous water effects to create maximum visual tension and fantasy.
In this flowercore scene, a neat indoor corridor breaks free from artificial order and is overtaken by wild grass and blooming flowers. The clean white walls and orderly doors and windows become little more than a backdrop for this unruly field of blossoms. Small blue-violet flowers spread freely through the green grass, as if the romance of the mountains and wilderness had been forced into this enclosed architectural space. At the end of the corridor, an intense light blurs the boundary between reality and dream, like an entrance to a hidden floral realm. Sunlight pours through the windows, casting a soft halo over the grass and flowers, yet the stark contrast between architecture and nature creates a strange, unsettling harmony. The familiar corridor is transformed into something unfamiliar by this invasion of plant life, evoking both a longing for nature and a sense of disorientation through its impossible fusion with the built environment. It is a vivid expression of flowercore aesthetics—using natural elements to disrupt the ordinary and create an atmosphere that feels both dreamlike and absurd.
A high aerial view of a hyper-real yet subtly generative expanse of green grass, soft and dense like velvet, with delicate undulations across the surface. The air feels moist, the light is softly diffused, and the overall atmosphere is quiet, pure, and restrained. At the center lies a shallow trace of naturally collected water, preserving only the light, flowing negative-space relationship of image1 without forming a complete, clear, or recognizable symbol. The watermark should appear naturally broken and intermittent, narrowing in places, with its edges gradually invaded and softened by the surrounding grass, like the scattered afterimage of a symbol dissolving back into nature rather than a shape deliberately cut into the field. The water surface gently reflects clouds in the sky, and at the center there is only a tiny, blurred, barely perceptible trace of a human reflection—never a clearly standing figure. A few very small distant bird-like shadow marks are scattered subtly across the scene. The overall image should have low contrast, light misting, soft diffusion, an ethereal restraint, and a delicate futuristic sensibility, like a dreamlike environmental image rather than natural landscape photography or an advertising poster.
In the photographic style of Su Junmin: understated and elegant, dominated by gray tones with subtle touches of orange, dark and moody, shaped by shadow-driven aesthetics. Linen-like grain texture, a relaxed atmosphere, dappled and fragmented light, and masterful use of light and shadow push the emotional tone to an extreme. A blurred boundary between clarity and ambiguity, strong color artistry, expressive emotional storytelling, and a surrealist sensibility. Exquisite composition, with a person, a car, and the wilderness forming a still, quiet frame. Wide-angle photography.
Hyper-realistic photography with surrealist detail: facial pores and individual eyelashes rendered with striking clarity, sweater fibers revealed in macro-level detail, and faint hints of an artist’s studio reflected in the glasses lenses, blurring the boundary between reality and art.
A surrealist 21:9 cinematic still. A giant red felt apple has been transformed into a miniature dwelling, with several lit square windows carved into its plush surface, revealing tiny domestic interiors bathed in warm light. A brick chimney rises from the top of the apple, releasing thick cotton-like smoke that drifts across the right side of the widescreen frame. A tiny solitary figure leans out of one of the windows, gazing toward the distant horizon. Use a Magritte-inspired palette of deep moody blues and soft crimson reds. Shot with a 100mm macro lens, with volumetric light filtering through the cottony smoke, and finished with Magritte’s signature clear blue sky and soft natural daylight.
A cute anthropomorphic rabbit astronaut runs across the rugged lunar surface toward the right, shown in a three-quarter side view and not facing the camera directly. It wears a worn, weathered white spacesuit with realistic scratches, dirt, detailed fabric texture, and a bulky life-support backpack, with no cartoonish elements. The rabbit has soft, realistic fur, and its long ears extend naturally from the helmet structure, without a clearly transparent helmet dome. Its expression is curious and brave.The scene is set in a vast, desolate moon landscape with uneven rocky terrain, craters, fine lunar dust, and subtle clouds of dust kicked up by its movement. A gigantic pale blue-gray planet dominates the background directly behind the rabbit, filling much of the frame with visible craters and surface texture. On the right side, a smaller moon-like planet appears in the distance. Beyond that is deep black outer space filled with bright stars and a faint blue nebula.Use a low-angle wide cinematic shot with a dramatic composition, placing the subject slightly right of center. Strong cold backlighting comes from the upper left, creating a beautiful bright rim light and a long dramatic shadow stretching to the right. The color palette should remain muted and cool.Ultra-realistic 3D render, high-end cinematic sci-fi fantasy, epic space adventure, realistic fur, detailed spacesuit, atmospheric depth, sharp focus, masterpiece.
Jewelry design with a singular, unconventional aesthetic, set against a highly saturated gradient background. The piece has a silver-white metallic finish, with its overall structure and fine details evolving from star-trail-inspired mutated forms, creating a subtly abstract visual language. Rendered with a premium CG look, every structural detail should be exquisitely refined and design-driven, with crisp, intricate textures and a sense of infinite detail. Strong contrast between light and shadow enhances the dramatic form. The silhouette should feel distinctive and masterfully designed, with exaggerated weapon-like styling and a modular, assembled construction.
Use image 1 as a concept sketch and transform it into a hyper-realistic, detail-rich 3D render. The rendering style must achieve photorealistic, studio-quality realism. Use soft, clean studio lighting that highlights the product’s silhouette, materiality, and surface detail. Set the object against a solid-color background to create a professional, premium product presentation atmosphere. Keep the final camera angle consistent with the original concept sketch, ensuring that the rendered image looks like a product photograph shot by a professional photographer in a studio.
Minimalist illustration style in a blue-green palette, with a rich royal-blue sky and a refined, artistic sensibility. A watercolor-inspired editorial illustration of Longcanggou National Forest Park, evoking the primitive forests near Chengdu, layered emerald streams and waterfalls, jade-like lakes, vast fir forests, and the crisp freshness of oxygen-rich mountain air. Use large blocks of color, with a tiny human figure placed within the scene to create a sense of scale, stillness, and quiet narrative. The composition should feel airy yet richly layered, with fresh, clean colors and dense speckled grain adding texture throughout. Blend abstract illustration with flat illustration aesthetics, aiming for a masterwork-like composition with a pure-color background and a sophisticated visual tone.
A minimalist, cool-toned blue mood portrait: a close side-profile shot of a woman with short black hair, wearing a black turtleneck sweater. Blue monochromatic lighting, low illumination, deep shadows, and a strong sense of silhouette. Crisp four-point star-shaped projected light spots and glowing star-like highlights. Minimal, cold, fashion-forward photography with a cinematic mood.

Generate a cinematic, large-scale action long take animation. Theme: A Chinese youth flies a kite through crowded streets, leaps up steps, flips and lands, dashes toward a high platform, and executes a difficult jump. The drumbeat erupts the moment he lands. One single continuous shot throughout, no cuts, fluid movements, clear weight, inertia, and landing cushioning. Style transition: 0–5s: Clear, highly saturated yet controlled Makoto Shinkai style, with moist reflections. 6–10s: Ink wash explosion; background buildings simplified with ink strokes, speed lines in dry-brush splatter style, drumbeats visualized as ink shockwaves. The protagonist and kite must remain clearly defined. 4K video, American military marching band with over 50 members parading on campus, sunny weather. Band in formal dark blue military uniforms with golden epaulets, marching in neat formation. Brass players perform classic military marches, drummers play steady rhythms, conductor leads with a baton. Background: cheering students, American flags, ancient red-brick campus buildings. Camera: dynamic tracking, alternating wide and medium shots, smooth movement. Audio: stereo brass melodies, drumbeats, crowd cheers. Atmosphere: bright, energetic, patriotic, warm sunlight tones.
Intense close-quarters combat (CQC) sequence. Subject: The short-haired female agent in tactical winter gear. Action: She is engaging in hand-to-hand combat with a mercenary in a snowy military base. The mercenary throws a punch, she dodges swiftly and counters with a brutal elbow strike to his face mask, followed by a heavy knee kick to the stomach. Physics: Visible shockwave ripple at the point of impact. Sweat and saliva flying in the air. The enemy's body folds from the pain. Camera: Dynamic handheld camera style, following the fist movement. Atmosphere: Cold breath vapor visible, gritty texture, high contrast lighting.
Epic cinematic video, slow-motion medium shot of a stoic young East Asian woman as a western cowboy, wearing a wide-brimmed felt hat and bandana, standing still while explosions and fire burst in the background behind her, black and white with warm orange light accents, dramatic chiaroscuro lighting on her face, wind blowing her hair, gritty film texture, high contrast, intense gaze, camera holds steady, motion blur on the background explosions, classic western movie aesthetic.
Single continuous cinematic shot, no music. From outside the glass window, the dim camera slowly pushes inward into a pizza shop. A bearded white male employee is baking pizza. He removes the pizza from the oven with a metal tray, places it into a red takeaway box, closes the lid, then hands it to a customer with a warm smile. Final shot: over-the-shoulder perspective.
Realistic style, Nordic snowy night. Shot 1: close tracking shot from behind at foot level — a man running fast through snow. Shot 2: front tracking shot — a wolf chasing closely behind. Strong sense of speed in both shots. The man trips and falls, rolling in snow. Shot 3: wide shot — wolf lunges toward fallen man. Shot 4: medium shot — wolf leaps toward camera. Suddenly a border collie jumps in from the side, knocking the wolf away. Camera follows quickly. Shot 5: close-up — two animals wrestling. After a moment, the wolf breaks free, jumps aside, and howls. Shot 6: wide shot — multiple wolves slowly approach, surrounding man and dog. Shot 7: close-up — the dog faces camera, owner slowly sitting up behind. The dog growls and barks threateningly, baring teeth. Background music: tense and evolving with the action.
Elegant cinematic video, slow-motion shot of a female ballet dancer performing a fluid, graceful pose in a tailored black suit over a crisp white shirt, arms extended, body twisting gently, dramatic spotlight cutting through a dark studio background, soft side lighting, smooth and elegant motion, professional commercial aesthetic, sharp focus on her movements, moody minimalist atmosphere, subtle camera pan following her movement.
Vertical ASMR video. No music. Macro details. Shot 1: A light blue skincare gel bottle sits on glass. A pale elegant hand gently taps the glass, producing crisp fingernail tapping sounds. Shot 2: The hand picks up the bottle and slowly twists the cap. The cap rotation sound is clearly audible. Shot 3: A spoon scoops a portion of gel. With a soft “plop,” a thick blob of pale blue gel lands heavily in the center of the glass surface. The gel is dense and viscous, containing tiny realistic air bubbles. Dramatic cool lighting from behind makes it glow like a gemstone. Shot 4: The hand presses firmly onto the gel. The pressure flattens it, causing it to spread outward into an irregular circle. Tiny bubbles swirl within the texture. Palm lines and skin details are clearly visible through the glass. The hand slowly spreads the gel in circular motions. The thick gel thins into a semi-transparent oily film. Focus entirely on friction and fluid dynamics between hand, product, and glass.
Based on the reference image, generate a time-lapse animation showing the living room transforming from an unfinished raw concrete interior to a fully renovated space. Final shot: all the lights switch on instantly, accompanied by a realistic light-switch sound effect.
Remove any visible production mistakes from the video.

Smooth transitions, the ball remains the visual focus, realistic cinematic style, strong athletic energy.

F A Q
What is Dreamina?
Dreamina is an all‑in‑one AI creative platform that lets you generate cinematic images, dynamic videos, and realistic talking avatars from simple text prompts, photos, or audio.
Is Dreamina free to use?
Yes. Dreamina provides free daily credits for generating images and videos, so you can start creating right away with no upfront payment.
Does Dreamina support generating both AI images and AI videos?
Yes. Dreamina AI works as both an AI image generator and an AI video generator. You can create high-resolution images from text prompts and turn them into dynamic videos—all within the same platform.
How is Dreamina different from other AI generation platforms?
Dreamina brings advanced AI models—like Seedance 2.0 for video, Seedream 5.0 Lite for high‑quality images, and Nano Banana Pro for enhanced creativity—together in a single, unified platform. By combining specialized, state‑of‑the‑art models for images, video, and digital humans, Dreamina enables creators to produce cinematic visuals, dynamic videos, and realistic avatars with precision, flexibility, and professional‑grade quality in a seamless workflow.
How is my data (uploads and generated content) protected?
Dreamina prioritizes user privacy. Your uploads and generated content are processed securely and are automatically removed after a defined period to protect your data.
